revision_id as revisionId, project_id as projectId, system_code as systemCode, screen_id as screenId, revision_no as revisionNo, source_fingerprint as sourceFingerprint, generator_version as generatorVersion, schema_version as schemaVersion, content_json as contentJson, document_html as documentHtml, bundle_path as bundlePath, bundle_manifest_json as bundleManifestJson, created_at as createdAt
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_screen_design (project_id, system_code, screen_id, generation_state, generation_id, generation_started_at, requested_source_fingerprint, requested_generator_version, requested_schema_version, failed_reason, retry_after, updated_at) values (#{projectId}, #{systemCode}, #{screenId}, 'RUNNING', #{generationId}, now(), #{sourceFingerprint}, #{generatorVersion}, #{schemaVersion}, null, null, now()) on conflict (project_id, system_code, screen_id) do update set generation_state = 'RUNNING', generation_id = excluded.generation_id, generation_started_at = excluded.generation_started_at, requested_source_fingerprint = excluded.requested_source_fingerprint, requested_generator_version = excluded.requested_generator_version, requested_schema_version = excluded.requested_schema_version, failed_reason = null, retry_after = null, updated_at = now() where (adk_builder_screen_design.generation_state != 'RUNNING' or adk_builder_screen_design.generation_started_at < #{staleBefore}) and (adk_builder_screen_design.retry_after is null or adk_builder_screen_design.retry_after <= #{retryNow})
mapper.select: select from builder.adk_builder_screen_design where project_id = #{projectId} and system_code = #{systemCode} and screen_id = #{screenId}

select revision.revision_id as revisionId, revision.project_id as projectId, revision.system_code as systemCode, revision.screen_id as screenId, revision.revision_no as revisionNo, revision.source_fingerprint as sourceFingerprint, revision.generator_version as generatorVersion, revision.schema_version as schemaVersion, revision.content_json as contentJson, revision.document_html as documentHtml, revision.bundle_path as bundlePath, revision.bundle_manifest_json as bundleManifestJson, revision.created_at as createdAt from builder.adk_builder_screen_design_revision revision join builder.adk_builder_screen_design current on current.current_revision_id = revision.revision_id where current.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_screen_design_revision (revision_id, project_id, system_code, screen_id, revision_no, source_fingerprint, generator_version, schema_version, content_json, document_html, bundle_path, bundle_manifest_json, created_at) values (#{revisionId}, #{projectId}, #{systemCode}, #{screenId}, #{revisionNo}, #{sourceFingerprint}, #{generatorVersion}, #{schemaVersion}, #{contentJson}, #{documentHtml}, #{bundlePath}, #{bundleManifestJson}, now())
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_screen_design set current_revision_id = #{revisionId}, current_revision_no = #{revisionNo}, generation_state = 'DONE', failed_reason = null, retry_after = null, updated_at = now() where project_id = #{projectId} and system_code = #{systemCode} and screen_id = #{screenId} and generation_id = #{generationId} and generation_state = 'RUNNING'

update builder.adk_builder_screen_design set generation_state = 'FAILED', failed_reason = #{reason}, retry_after = #{retryAfter}, updated_at = now() where project_id = #{projectId} and system_code = #{systemCode} and screen_id = #{screenId} and generation_id = #{generationId} and generation_state = 'RUNNING'
